image_description: A close-up portrait of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) resting on a patterned blanket against a solid pink background. The dog has characteristic chestnut and white markings, long feathered ears, and large dark eyes. A black leash is visible in the upper right.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape shows a distinct dome between the ears, and the muzzle is short with a clear stop. The nose appears short and slightly upturned, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are prominent, dark, and round. They are set relatively wide apart, contributing to the gentle expression typical of the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ears are clearly visible, hanging low beside the head, and exhibit significant long, silky feathering/fringe.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat displays the classic Blenheim pattern: a white blaze on the face and chest, with rich chestnut/red patches covering the ears and parts of the head/body. The boundaries are reasonably distinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears soft and silky rather than wiry or curly. Feathering is evident on the ears and visible parts of the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight close-up of the head and shoulders; the full body length and 'cobby' structure cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The legs are mostly obscured by the blanket and the framing of the shot. Hindquarters are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.
The subject is stationary/resting, so gait cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow/brown patterned fabric in the immediate foreground has a slightly smudged, painterly quality compared to the sharper focus on the dog's face. It lacks distinct weave detail, appearing somewhat melted into the depth of field.
The black leash enters the frame but its attachment point to the collar/harness is ambiguous and seems to blend slightly into the fur/background without a clear clip or ring structure.
